# Analytics & Trust Checklist: 004-risk-analytics-trust

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for financial modeling, path simulation, and LLM trust/provenance
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Financial Modeling & Path Simulation

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact formulas or standard conventions specified for calculating expected shares and P&L percentiles? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are edge case behaviors explicitly defined for zero or negative volatility inputs? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements for knock-out observation style (discrete daily close) consistently applied across all path logic? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the statistical significance criteria (e.g., standard error bounds) defined for the 10,000 paths default? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK005 Are error handling requirements specified when the underlying correlation matrix is not positive semi-definite? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Can the maximum loss bounded/unbounded statement logic be objectively verified against all product types? [Measurability, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the requirements for historical replay rolling windows clearly bounded in terms of lookback duration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]

## LLM Trust & Provenance

- [ ] CHK008 Are the fallback behaviors explicitly defined when extraction partially fails or encounters conflicting terms? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the UI behavior clearly specified for when a user overrides an `Inferred` field back to `Missing`? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the requirements for the benchmark report metrics (exact-match rate, missing-detection rate) mathematically unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the specification detail the exact handling of personally identifiable information (PII) if accidentally extracted? [Completeness, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK012 Are state transition requirements defined for when a `User-Supplied` field is later re-extracted by the LLM? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the definition of a "synthetic termsheet" quantified for the benchmark corpus? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the UI/UX requirements for presenting the `source_text` citations to the advisor clear and consistent? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
